CqrsLens 0.2.0 — see your MediatR codebase.

Usage: cqrslens <path> [-o OUTPUT] [--format md|html] [--markers ICommand,IQuery] [--strict]

  <path>        Folder of the .NET solution to scan (searched recursively).
  -o, --output  Report path. Default: ARCHITECTURE.md (or .html) in the current directory.
  --format      Report format: md (default) or html. A .html -o path implies html.
  --markers     Comma-separated custom marker interface names that also count
                as request roots (e.g. ICommand,IQuery,IMessage). Requests hidden
                behind interfaces deriving from IRequest are always followed.
  --strict      Exit with code 4 when architecture checks report any error.
  -h, --help    Show this help.

Exit codes: 0 ok · 1 usage error · 2 path not found · 3 no projects found · 4 strict check failure.
